sections.title: 主要结果
sections.text:
《Chemical discrimination of wild and cultivated Dendrobium devonianum by ATR-FTIR spectroscopy and machine learning with targeted metabolomic analysis》：结果的原文依据；数值与适用人群以引文为准。

【Abstract · abstract-1-5】Three of 36 preprocessing-model combinations achieved 100% accuracy in an initial 43-sample test set.

【Abstract · abstract-1-6】However, repeated stratified five-fold cross-validation (10 repeats) yielded a highest mean balanced accuracy of 0.9522 ± 0.0496 for partial least-squares discriminant analysis of raw spectra, providing a more cautious assessment of discrimination performance.

evidence.text: Three of 36 preprocessing-model combinations achieved 100% accuracy in an initial 43-sample test set.

However, repeated stratified five-fold cross-validation (10 repeats) yielded a highest mean balanced accuracy of 0.9522 ± 0.0496 for partial least-squares discriminant analysis of raw spectra, providing a more cautious assessment of discrimination performance.
